newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila call loan rates unchanged in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila call loan rates unchanged in liquid market.

text.p: Philippine interbank call loan rates were unchanged at 10.8125 percent on Thursday in a liquid market, traders said.
About one billion pesos from the net inflow of matured T-bills were added to the system, they said.
Banks are concerned liquidity could be tight late in the month and over the new year due to holiday spending, dealers said.
"Although everybody is liquid, nobody's willing to lock in their money in the near term," said a foreign bank dealer.
Done rates in the interbank market were at 11 to 10.78125 percent, with 20 lenders and 24 borrowers.
Volume rose to 16.810 billion from 12.350 billion pesos.
In the secondary market for T-bills, banks were mostly on the selling side, dealers said.
"Few were buying due to year-end concerns," a dealer said.
Three-month bills were offer from 11.40 to 11.425 percent; the six months at 11.715 to 11.80; and one year at 12.05 to 12.10, traders said. - LILIAN KARUNUNGAN (632) 841-8937
